cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in the Social Media & Marketing Specialist role at Yusen Logistics. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am drawn to Yusen Logistics' commitment to innovation and global connectivity. I am confident that my skills in social media coordination, content planning, and performance analysis align well with the responsibilities of this 12-month maternity cover position.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and maintain client websites. I have also applied my expertise to my own project, mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site with integrated social media (Instagram/Facebook) and implemented structured data to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This experience has honed my ability to translate brand guidelines into engaging content and to use analytics tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush to measure and optimise performance.

I am particularly excited about the opportunity to support Yusen Logistics' global social media strategy and work with regional teams. My ability to combine creative thinking with analytical reporting, along with my strong project management skills, positions me to contribute effectively to your corporate communications team. I am proactive, collaborative, and eager to learn, and I thrive in multicultural environments.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit Yusen Logistics.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
